svg.title: Beta: v0.1.52-beta52 has been runtime-tested with Twitch only
svg.desc: Other platforms and RTMP services are untested. Start and stop streaming from the Active Live Delay dock, not OBS's normal Start Streaming button.

g.text: Current version has runtime acceptance on Twitch only.
Other platforms and RTMP services have not been tested.
Use the Active Live Delay dock, not OBS Start Streaming.
